title: Native run of loader-diag-xnu-rm-md1 (decision 0034): kernel command line ends in xrd=md0 so that Apple's launchd enters restore/ramdisk mode and skips the boot tasks (launchd_cache_loader among them); does launchd stay alive and run the one job twice
